      SHIVAS TECHNOLOGY LIMITED

      SG500 Spin Galvanizing Plant · 500 t/month

      Fasteners M10–M36, one part number per basket, from bins to galvanized, quenched and weighed. Rev E. Semi-automatic: the machine does the hot, repetitive moves; operators charge, skim the ash bay and inspect. Pretreatment drums with their own hanger motors, a carousel dryer, a 1.35 m DSQ kettle with high-velocity burners, a fixed spin hood with a red skimming flap and basket vanes, a gravity-opening basket with a curved core, fixed recipes for every size, and SHIVAS ZFE, AFE, flux filtration, regeneration and zinc ash recovery.
